sloka: रावणश्च दुराधर्षो हतः सबलवाहनः ।वानराश्च वशं नीता ऋक्षाश्च सह राक्षसैः ।। ७.४३.१५ ॥
transliteration: rāvaṇaśca durādharṣo hataḥ sabalavāhanaḥ ।vānarāśca vaśaṁ nītā ṛkṣāśca saha rākṣasaiḥ ।। 7.43.15 ॥

translations.english: The formidable Rāvaṇa was killed along with his army and vehicles, and the monkeys and bears were brought under control along with the Rākṣasas.
